watchlist_releases.name: Newton v1.8.0rc2
watchlist_releases.body:
# Newton v1.8.0rc2

Newton v1.8.0rc2 is the second release candidate for Newton 1.8, following v1.7.0. It introduces the experimental Steel articulated rigid-body solver and adds routed tendons, richer deformable workflows, core passive joint springs, and a new Kamino dynamics backend, along with broad collision and model-building performance work. Please validate existing scenes against the migration notes below, especially XPBD stiffness tuning, Rod joints, imported joint springs, MuJoCo kinematic roots, and console output that now goes through the `newton` logger.

For the complete release scope and migration details, see the [consolidated changelog](https://github.com/newton-physics/newton/blob/v1.8.0rc2/CHANGELOG.md). This candidate adds the surface-gripper example and includes further Steel, MJCF import, collision, rendering and example-stability fixes. Please re-test affected scenes before the final release.

## Highlights

- **Surface-gripper example.** A recorded robot palletizing task demonstrates vacuum/suction pads with spring-damper seals, seal-quality monitoring and configurable release criteria. (#3974)

- **Experimental: Steel articulated rigid-body solver.** `SolverSteel` combines Featherstone articulated-body dynamics with a projected Gauss-Seidel contact solve that has coupled Coulomb friction. It supports friction patches, loop-closing and mimic joints, joint friction, opt-in run-to-run determinism, passive-island sleeping, CUDA graph capture, and use insi
